editorial.blurb: This unassuming Chinatown gem serves exceptionally fresh sushi, ramen, and udon with the kind of quality and consistency that keeps locals coming back weekly.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a party tray for groups—reviewers rave about the 90+ piece assortment—or ask the super-friendly staff for their house rolls; they know regulars' orders by heart.
signatureDishes: Udon broth with thick chewy noodles
Ramen with savory broth and wood ear mushrooms
Sushi rolls with high-grade tuna and salmon
